paper_title: First results from BRASS-p broadband searches for hidden photon dark matter
notes: First science run (SR1) of BRASS-p dish-antenna-style broadband HP search, 12-18 GHz (49.63-74.44 ueV). No signal candidate found; paper reports measured 1-sigma detection sensitivity of chi ~ (0.3-1.0)e-13 across the band (Figs. 11-12), assuming rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 and unpolarized HP DM. No numerical table given; data_points approximate the stated envelope: ~1e-13 near band edges with best sensitivity ~3e-14 mid-band. Quoted as 1-sigma sensitivity rather than a formal 90/95% CL exclusion; a dedicated signal search is deferred to future work.
